output.question: Who is Goldman Sachs' CTO?
output.answer: I couldn't find anyone holding the title of firm-wide Chief Technology Officer at Goldman Sachs as of November 2026. Goldman's top technology executive is Marco Argenti, its Chief Information Officer. Fortune called him 'Goldman Sachs' tech boss' in May 2026, with roughly 12,000 engineers reporting to him. The last named firm-wide CTO was Atte Lahtiranta, who joined in 2019 and left for Citadel in August 2024 to lead its core engineering group. I found no announced successor to Lahtiranta.

key_facts.fact: Marco Argenti is Goldman Sachs' chief information officer and is described as the firm's 'tech boss'.
Goldman announced in 2019 that Atte Lahtiranta would join as partner and Chief Technology Officer, and that Marco Argenti would join as co-CIO.
Bloomberg reported that Goldman CTO Atte Lahtiranta was leaving for Citadel.

passages.quote: Goldman Sachs chief information officer Marco Argenti
Citadel Nabs Goldman Tech Chief in Latest Poach From Wall Street

caveats: Goldman's official leadership page returned HTTP 403, so I couldn't check directly whether a firm-wide CTO is listed now.
Goldman may have a CTO who was never publicly announced, or CTOs at the divisional level. My searches found no CTO named after Lahtiranta left in August 2024.
The Bloomberg Law article is paywalled. I could see only its headline and date (Aug 20, 2024), not whether it names a successor.

The 2019 press release passage and Lahtiranta's Citadel role (head of core engineering) come from search-result snippets (Goldman press release, Hedgeweek, MarketScreener). I did not open those pages myself.
